data.name: Kanakprasad
data.gender_notes: Kanakprasad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kanakprasad is a Sanskrit name composed of two words: 'Kanaka' meaning gold and 'Prasad' meaning grace or offering. This name is a tribute to Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow blessings of wealth and prosperity. The name Kanakprasad carries the meaning “Golden grace, offering to Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanakprasad usually hope their child will grow to embody golden grace, offering to lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: An offering of gold to the deity, symbolizing devotion and reverence.
data.etymology: Kanakprasad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden grace, offering to Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanakprasad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Kanakprasad was a famous poet and philosopher of the Bhakti movement in medieval India. He was a contemporary of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu (1486-1534).

Kanakprasad Thakur was an influential Vaishnava poet and saint from the Shakta-Vaishnava tradition of Bengal. He was born around 1606 and is said to have met Chaitanya Mahaprabhu when he was only eight years old.
